reasons20.title: 20 Reasons Why
reasons20.subtitle: Twenty little things that make you the most extraordinary person I know. Tap each card to unveil the memory.

reasons.text: The way you scrunch your nose when laughing uncontrollably
Your endless empathy and baby talk for every stray cat we pass
Your midnight tea rituals and soft quiet hums while waiting for water to boil
How your warm hug instantly silences all my doubts and anxiety
The way your eyes dance whenever you spot a vintage bookstore window
Singing completely off-key with total confidence to our roadtrip playlists
How you make 3 AM conversations feel like uncovering secrets of the universe
The way you fiercely protect the people you love with your whole heart
Your adorable sleepy voice when you pick up the phone first thing in the morning
Ordering dessert first because 'life is too short to wait for sugar'
The pride and quiet glow on your face when you master something hard
How you remember tiny passing details I mentioned weeks ago
Your infectious laugh that turns any gloomy rainy room into pure sunshine
How safe and grounded my entire soul feels whenever my hand is in yours
Your fierce curiosity about the world, the stars, and how things work
The funny faces you pull when you're deeply concentrating on something
The way you listen with your whole being, never just waiting for your turn to speak
How you look in my oversized hoodies, pulling the sleeves over your hands
Your unwavering belief in me even when I struggled to believe in myself
Simply because you are Isha—my once-in-a-lifetime person, today and for all chapters ahead
